newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: SOCCER-MOLDOVA NAME UNCHANGED SQUAD FOR ITALY GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MOLDOVA NAME UNCHANGED SQUAD FOR ITALY GAME.

text.p: unchanged squad from that beaten 2-1 by Poland last November for
Saturday's World Cup European group two qualifier against Italy
Goalkeepers: Denis Romanenco (Zimbru Chisinau), Evgheny Ivanov (Tiligul Tiraspol)
Defenders: Vasily Tolokonnikov (Zimbru Chisinau), Serghei Secu (Tiligul Tiraspol), Oleg Fistican (Zimbru Chisinau), Ion Testemitianu (Zimbru Chisinau), Vitaly Culibaba (Zimbru Chisinau)

Midfielders: Oleg Siscan (Constructorul Chisinau), Vladimir Gaidamasciuc (Tiligul Tiraspol), Serghei Epureanu (Zimbru Chisinau), Alexandr Popovici (Tiligul Tiraspol), Boris Cibotaru (Zimbru Chisinau), Radu Rebeja (Zimbru Chisinau), Marin Spinu (Zimbru Chisinau), Alexandr Curtianu (Widzew Lodz, Poland) Forwards: Serghei Clescenco (Go Ahead Eagles, Netherlands),
